simple.meaning: to approach (causatively, bring near ) for whatever purpose
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to קָרַב (H7126) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

definitions.short: to approach (causatively, bring near ) for whatever purpose
definitions.usage: (cause to) approach, (cause to) bring (forth, near), (cause to) come (near, nigh), (cause to) draw near (nigh), go (near), be at hand, join, be near, offer, present, produce, make ready, stand, take.
